title: Geometric extremal graphical models and coefficients of extremal dependence on block graphs
summary: We introduce the concept of geometric extremal graphical models, which are defined through the gauge function of the limit set obtained from suitably scaled random vectors in light-tailed margins. For block graphs, we prove results relating to the propagation of various extremal dependence coefficients along the graph. A particular focus is placed on coefficients that link to the framework of conditional extreme value theory, which are especially interesting when variables do not all attain their most extreme values simultaneously.
